g.title: receive
g.text: Receive start-of-substep stress and history, strain increment,
material properties and end-of-increment field temperature
p = ustatev(1): accumulated equivalent plastic strain

g.title: conditions
g.text: Select T: prop(1), or Temp + dTemp if NINT(prop(6)) = 1
Rate = prop(2) is fixed; density = prop(3); model G = prop(4)
Elastic Ge = prop(7) when positive, otherwise model G; ν = prop(5)

g.title: trial
g.text: Form isotropic elastic stiffness Ce from Ge and ν
Trial stress = start stress + Ce : strain increment
Compute trial von Mises stress q_trial; initialise dp = 0

g.title: flow0
g.text: Call JCPFLW at p → view C
Get initial flow stress σy(p), slope H and range flags

g.title: merge0
g.text: Merge the initial evaluation's flags into the history flag

g.title: plastic
g.text: Safeguarded Newton: at most 50 local evaluations
On success: corrected stress, dp, final flow stress and tangent

g.title: finish
g.text: On success, update returned plastic-strain tensor and energies
p_new = p + dp; return stress, tangent, epseq and shear stiffness
SVAR1 = p_new; SVAR2 = current flow stress
SVAR3 = persistent accepted range flags; SVAR4 = local iteration count

g.title: cut
g.text: ISTAT = 1: local Newton did not converge
Set keycut = 1 and return: ask ANSYS to bisect the substep
Do not return a successful updated state → A recovery path

g.title: back
g.text: Return successful trial material response to ANSYS → A
ANSYS accepts / commits history only when the substep converges

g.title: note
g.text: Supported wrapper: 3D, plane strain and axisymmetric; three direct components.
Plane-stress, beam and shell wrappers are not provided. Small-strain J2 model.
The checks shown are the implemented checks, not a claim of exhaustive input validation.
Thermal coupling tangent terms are not supplied; this is not a coupled thermomechanical law.

g.title: err
g.text: Interface: insufficient properties / state or wrong direct components
ISTAT 2: nonpositive model backbone / strain term
These are error returns, not automatic keycut = 1 paths
